nodes.label: Node ID format rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must be {full_repo_relative_stem}_{entity}, using every directory level, deterministic from the label alone, so AST and semantic extractors converge on the same node instead of creating ghost duplicates.

nodes.label: Confidence score rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete rubric (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) replaces continuous 0-1 scoring because models collapse continuous ranges to a bimodal distribution around 0.5 and 0.85+; forces an explicit judgment call instead.
